frozen_actor_identity.note: identity/legacy-check evidence only; not an image-path safety certificate
frozen_actor_identity.inference: deterministic actor mean clipped to [-3,3]; no QP; no SBC action filtering

config.paper_adaptation: DINO CLS 384, NOT full 16x16 patch tokens; no paper-controller/barrier reproduction
config.horizon_actions: observed/planned future controls supplied to every arm equally; open-loop prediction
config.selection: validation 3-horizon mean common frozen-R2 latent RMSE
limitations: same-policy old trajectories, not random-action coverage
prediction comparison not a formal safety guarantee
config.physical_diagnostic_scope: At each predicted observation time, use its true speed ONLY for the frozen-PPO diagnostic; compare predicted-latent and real-image-latent actions in the SAME state. Successor gap is one physical step AFTER that observation, not the forecast speed target. No true future speed/latent/distance is supplied to learned predictors.

persistence32.kind: no training; last image latent repeated

current_q_known_distance.kind: current proxy; true FUTURE distance supplied, not a forecast competitor

runtime_scope: sum of learning-arm training/selection; excludes final evaluations and initial baselines
finalization_note: Source paths converted to Path for checksum; no weights/metrics changed by finalizer
